Today’s lunch specials: FRIED CHICKEN & BAKED HAM. If you need to place an order, please give us a call. 910-327-2011 910-327-7551. 119 Hall Pt. Rd. Sneads Ferry, NC 28460

HAPPY VETERANS DAY! For today only, come in and show your active military or veteran id and get a free Pulled Pork Sandwich on us! Thank you to all who served and have served. Our Smoked Chicken and Dumplings are a fan favorite! Come and grab some today so you can know why!
We are veteran owned and grateful for all who have served. Veterans, enjoy a shrimp or chicken basket on us today!

Happy Veterans Day from the whole Shak fam! We’re so proud of our veteran-owned Shaks and the people behind them who have served our country and now serve their communities. If you’ve ever thought about owning your own Shak, head to our website to learn more about our partnership with VetFran, a program that helps veterans explore franchise ownership. To all veterans and active-duty service members, THANK YOU for your service. Swing by the Shak today for a FREE drink and 4 oz. of queso or guacamole with any entrée purchase! (In-store only on November 11.)

Today, we’re especially grateful for the brave men and women who have served our country and the sacrifices they’ve made to protect the freedoms we enjoy. From our Coastal Wing & Spirits Co. family to yours, thank you for your service. We’re proud to serve our community, and even prouder to honor those who have served us. Happy Veterans Day!
